finding.title: OS Command Injection
finding.trigger: An attacker could input a malicious string that includes command injection vectors (e.g., `Abbreviation: ; rm -rf /`)
finding.assumptions: The `Console.WriteLine()` is executed in a context where the attacker could manipulate the command line or execute arbitrary commands.

parsed.refutation_attempt: 1. Verified that the only use of the untrusted input from Console.ReadLine() occurs in the menu choice parsing and the team abbreviation printing. 2. Console.WriteLine() is a pure output function and does not execute shell commands; it simply writes to the standard output stream. 3. No path exists from the untrusted input to any system or process invocation that would allow command execution. 4. The claimed attack vector would require the console output to be interpreted by a shell, which is not the case in a standard C# console application. 5. The code does not invoke any Process.Start, command interpreter, or similar, so OS command injection is impossible.
